verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a pip-installable Python library with a programmatic graph API (stream/astream, Command, checkpointers) and a CLI that builds/runs an Agent Server locally, all of which support non-interactive, scriptable execution suitable for CI/automation. However, there is no explicit documentation or example of running LangGraph in a CI pipeline or headless automation context specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guide or example, documented headless/non-interactive invocation patterns, and independent evidence of real-world CI usage.
